verdict.rationale: Warp is an HR/payroll platform with a public API, so a sandbox or test environment is a fair question to ask of it. The pack never mentions a sandbox, test mode, or isolated non-production data. The pricing line about 'free developer access' versus production workflows describes plan tiers, not an isolated test environment, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
